lines.text: David writes that God's name is majestic in all the earth and His glory is set above the heavens.
God has ordained praise from the mouths of priests and infants to silence the enemy and avenger.
David looks at the heavens, the work of God's fingers, and asks what man is that God cares for him.
God made man a little lower than the angels, crowned him with glory, and made him servant of His works.
God placed sheep, oxen, beasts of the field, birds and fish under man's feet, and David ends praising His name.
